origin: Independent frozen C API and original GGUF writer/quantizers. No Rust numeric outputs read.
packing: Original JSON float values losslessly encoded back to f32 little-endian; identical rows/input data deduplicated with SHA-256 and full byte equality.
model_adaptation: None. The frozen original converter consumed the unmodified pinned official Pythia-14M checkpoint.
scope: Dense causal uniform-head GPT-NeoX with positive even partial/full NeoX RoPE and parallel/sequential residual. Zero RoPE, odd head width, noncausal and per-layer arrays remain explicitly unsupported. No GPU or native C-context GPT-NeoX claim.

synthetic_vocabulary_source.scope: Existing independently generated 512-token fixture; synthetic graph inputs are not pretrained Pythia evidence.
